{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Display basic info
print(data.info())
print("\nFirst few rows:")
print(data.head())

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = data['revenue'] == '999999.99'
print(f"\nNumber of QA orders: {qa_mask.sum()}")

# Clean revenue: remove commas and cast to float
# First, convert revenue to string to ensure consistency
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
# Only keep completed orders with valid revenue (non-QA)
data_clean = data[(data['status'] == 'completed') & (~qa_mask)]

# Check the cleaned data
print(f"\nAfter filtering: {len(data_clean)} rows")
print(f"Unique channels: {data_clean['channel'].unique()}")
print(f"Unique customer segments: {data_clean['customer_segment'].unique()}")

# Check if channel is randomly assigned
print(f"\nChannel distribution by customer_segment:")
print(data_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].count())"}
